what_it_is: Threaded sacroiliac joint fusion implant with 3D-printed porous titanium (FuSIon 3D) surface for osseointegration. Features TORQLock hooked thread profile to reduce toggle, IntelliHarvest helical flutes and fenestrations for bone self-harvesting, and EZDrive self-drilling self-tapping tip that decreases surgical steps. Two minimally invasive approach options (lateral transiliac).
indications: Minimally invasive surgical fusion of the sacroiliac (SI) joint.
use_notes: Sheep model histology (6-week) showed 11.5 Nm max torque-out for iFuse TORQ vs 0.5 Nm for traditional screws (Technical Study 300940-TS). STACI trial: prospective multicenter study demonstrating safety and effectiveness.
